db.description: Path to the SQLite database file used to track synchronization state

root.description: Absolute path of the local directory tree to synchronize

host.description: Remote host (with optional user@ prefix) to synchronize to

exclude_list.description: List of shell glob patterns specifying files/directories to exclude from sync

cipher.description: SSH cipher to use for data encryption (e.g., 'aes128-ctr', 'chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com', or 'none' to disable)

parallel_jobs.description: Number of file transfers to run in parallel

use_hardlinks.description: Whether to use hardlinks for deduplication during sync

compress.description: Whether to compress data during transfer

remote_cmd.description: Custom command to use for fssync on the remote host (e.g., '/usr/local/bin/fssync-server')

ssh_key.description: Path to SSH private key file (e.g., ~/.ssh/id_ed25519)

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate the sync without making changes

force_resync.description: If true, ignore database state and resync everything

ssh_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for SSH connection establishment

block_size.description: Size of fixed blocks used for sparse file diffing (bytes)

max_files_per_dir.description: Maximum number of files to process per directory scan (0 = unlimited)
